title: JPL Viking mission lead believed there was evidence of life on Mars

tellings.quote: I've heard that the JPL guy who was in charge of the Viking missions also swears by there being sort of, you know, evidence of life on Mars

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says he has heard that the person at the Jet Propulsion Laboratory, NASA's spacecraft lab, who led the Viking missions, the 1970s probes sent to land on Mars, firmly believes there was evidence of life on Mars. If true, it would mean someone at the center of the search thinks life beyond Earth was already found.
